speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Hypothyroidism with incidental Guillain-Barré Syndrome. The hypothyroidism explains your fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, and hoarseness, while the GBS is a separate confirmed neurological condition.
